system.desc: The Hero has trained her memory to be as exact and precise.
system.benefit: If Hero commits to memorizing something, she can recite it, without error, at any later date. It generally takes three times as long to memorize a passage than it does to simply read it. This discipline also helps when manipulating the energies of the universe. Dynamism Mental Fatigue penalties are reduced by the Hero’s INT (minimum -3).
